fusions.name: Strike from Stillness
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it and consuming them. Against an enemy that has not yet bled, it has 40% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Heat Shimmer Rush
fusions.desc: The sun-warmed swarm lunges across a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Basking Cloud
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Moulted Husk
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
